newsitem.title: USA: Transworld Healthcare in deal to sell HMI.
newsitem.headline: Transworld Healthcare in deal to sell HMI.

text.p: Transworld HealthCare Inc on Thursday said that Counsel Corp had agreed to buy all of the businesses and operations of Health Management Inc for roughly $40 million.
The transaction, which will be in the form of an asset sale, is expected to close on September 17 and is subject to the purchase of HMI by Transworld, the company said.
Alternatively, Counsel Corp must enter into an agreement directly with HMI for the transaction to go forward, Transworld said in a statement.
Transworld added that during the third quarter of fiscal 1997 it anticipated taking a pre-tax non-cash charge of about $20 million related to the deal.
The sale of HMI is expected to generate cash proceeds in excess of $25 million, the company said.

"The sale of HMI affords Transworld the opportunity to continue to emphasize the delivery of integrated, cost-effective healthcare at home and to concentrate on meeting the needs of payors," the company said.
Transworld HealthCare is a regional provider of alternate site healthcare services and products, while HMI provides pharmacy management services.
